stories.headline: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart adds Ornith-1.0 coding models
stories.summary: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart now offers DeepReinforce AI's Ornith-1.0-9B and Ornith-1.0-35B open-source models. These models are built specifically to assist with agentic coding tasks.
stories.whyItMatters: Developers can easily access specialized open-source coding models directly within AWS infrastructure.

stories.headline: DeepSeek-V4 models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
stories.summary: DeepSeek has made its V4-Pro, V4-Flash, and V4.1-Flash models available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. These open-weight language models are licensed under the MIT license.
stories.whyItMatters: Enterprise users gain immediate access to DeepSeek models with open licensing through managed AWS services.

stories.headline: AWS launches Web Search API for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
stories.summary: Amazon introduced a Web Search API on Bedrock AgentCore that lets developers search the web using a single API call. The tool returns ranked results with text extracts and metadata without requiring separate gateway configurations.
stories.whyItMatters: This simplifies adding real-time web search capabilities to AI agents built on Amazon Bedrock.

stories.headline: AWS recaps October 2026 updates for AI builders on Bedrock
stories.summary: Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore received several updates in October 2026, including new models, improved cost tracking, and features to keep production agents grounded. These additions aim to improve reliability for deployed AI agents.
stories.whyItMatters: Teams building production AI applications get better visibility and reliability controls on AWS.

stories.headline: DXC Technology builds multi-model AI system on Amazon Bedrock
stories.summary: DXC Technology implemented a governed multi-model AI platform on Amazon Bedrock for its managed IT services. The system uses Bedrock Guardrails and AWS PrivateLink to protect AI agents operating in regulated sectors.
stories.whyItMatters: Regulated industries can deploy multi-model AI systems securely using enterprise governance features.

stories.headline: Google introduces Gemini Decisions API for multimodal tasks
stories.summary: Google launched the Gemini Decisions API, powered by the Gemini Decision 1 model, to handle closed-set tasks like tool selection and policy checks. The endpoint evaluates multimodal inputs in a single forward pass to provide probabilities and confidence scores with low latency.
stories.whyItMatters: Developers get a fast and cost-effective API for structured decision-making tasks across text, images, audio, and video.

stories.headline: New research proposes faster retrieval methods for RAG systems
stories.summary: A recent research paper examines improvements to maximum inner product search, a core part of retrieval-augmented generation. The proposed methods account for differences between short queries and long document keys to increase search speed.
stories.whyItMatters: Optimized retrieval techniques can make large-scale RAG systems faster and more efficient.

stories.headline: llama.cpp adds support for FP8 KV-cache
stories.summary: A newly merged pull request in llama.cpp adds support for 8-bit floating-point precision in the key-value cache. This feature helps optimize memory usage and execution performance for open-source LLM inference.
stories.whyItMatters: Local LLM runners can operate with lower memory overhead and improved efficiency.

stories.headline: Embodied First Exam benchmark tests coding agents on robotics tasks
stories.summary: Researchers introduced the Embodied First Exam framework with over 1,100 tasks to test whether coding agents can control physical robots. The study found that top agents achieved a 34% success rate, indicating substantial room for progress.
stories.whyItMatters: Standardized evaluations help measure and guide the development of agents capable of controlling physical hardware.
